title: Speciation & drug resistance testing for all samples
agency_path: City of New York > Health and Mental Hygiene
description_text: Health Research Incorporated (HRI), who is designated as a research institute and membership corporation affiliated with the NYS Department of Health (NYS DOH), will provide DOHMH with support, supplement or extend the functions and programs of NYS DOH, for speciation & drug resistance testing. Under this sole source contract, the NYS DOH Wadsworth Center, Mycobacteriology Laboratory will perform Tuberculosis (TB) molecular testing services, including deletion analysis, targeted next generation sequencing (tNGS), and whole genome sequencing (WGS) to perform to ensure rapid, accurate, and comprehensive TB diagnostic and genotyping capacity.
